Source: http://www.kubby.com/AMMA.html

Posted May 22, 2000
(MarijuanaNews note: Pope John 23rd said that " Americans are God’s guinea pigs. "

He might have better said that about Californians. For better and for worse, California is the incubator of innovations in DEAland. Certainly, this has been the case with medical marijuana. Prop 215 was the first medical marijuana initiative to pass, and the state leads in the number of medical marijuana patients, buyers clubs, etc.

There is a dark side to this, however. California also leads the nation in the direct subversion of the rule of law. Not since the end of official segregation has there been such a wholesale assault on the rights of individuals and Constitutional government – by the very people who are sworn to uphold the law, so-called " law-enforcement. " In much of the state, the police and prosecutors simply refuse to accept the medical marijuana law. But the problem goes far beyond medical marijuana. The suppression of cannabis remains their ideological North Star.
See
How Marijuana Prohibition Corrupts All Of Our Institutions
– Medicine, Law Enforcement, Journalism
And How That Corruption Sustains Prohibitionism

Steve Kubby, as both a libertarian activist and medical marijuana advocate, has long been a critic of overreaching government, but he was thrust into the maelstrom at a practical level by his own arrest and political prosecution by ideologically-blinded law enforcement in Placer County, California.

MarijuanaNews has devoted a lot of coverage to the Kubby case because I like the work that Kubby is doing.

More importantly, his case casts a light on the ideological corruption of the criminal justice system. Kubby’s analysis of the process demonstrates that the base of political power in DEAland rests with the local police mechanism at the county level.
See

The Kubbys and The Prosecutor – An Insight into Pathological Prosecution

In short, what is being revealed in this process is that the entire political system – Constitutional government – is being subverted by this prohibitionist ideology. In fact, marijuana prohibition is the core problem in the subversion of the rule of law in most of the Western world.

Countries with less developed political institutions are even more vulnerable to this process, but even the most advance and civilized nations are at risk. Exactly the same thing is going on in Canada. Fortunately, the political power of the Canadian police is far less menacing than in DEAland.

See
Great Canadian Editorial Calls for Legalization; Decries Justice Minister's Giving Narks Veto Over Changing Marijuana Laws.

There are two items below. The first is an essay by Steve Kubby, which outlines the problem. The second is a report from another California medical marijuana activist who is also on the front lines. The law enforcement practices, which she describes, demonstrate the extent of the problem that Kubby indicts.

The police are isolated behind a closed information system which perfectly complements an " us against them " cultural isolation.
See
Chairman of the International Drug Strategy Institute Lies To Local Paper As Well As Internationally.
and links

The Los Angeles police department has represented the extreme of this process in large cities, but it is even worse in rural areas, where there are fewer challenges to the prevailing ideology. Not so coincidentally, LA is the home of DARE and the largest of the national police scandals. In New York, which is second to LA in the current police scandalathon, marijuana prohibition was the direct source of the most recent police shooting of an unarmed black man. The Giuliani administration takes pride in having increased marijuana arrests enormously.
See
New York Times Reports The Numbers In City’s Soaring Marijuana Arrests:
A Journalistic Breakthrough?

There is a growing criticism of the whole " war on drugs ", but until the critics take a hard look at what is really going on, which means taking the marijuana issues seriously, they will never be able to grasp the deadly nature of the problem.

They will then understand that the survival of Constitutional government hangs in the balance.)

DARE to call it TREASON!
by Steve Kubby
May 22, 2000

" Single acts of tyranny may be ascribed to the accidental opinion of a day; but a series of oppressions, begun at a distinguished period, and pursued unalterably through every change of ministers, too plainly prove a deliberate systematical job of reducing us to slaves. " --Thomas Jefferson


Every elected official, police officer and military officer has taken a sworn oath to " Protect and defend the Constitution from all enemies, foreign and domestic. " With this oath, each member of government is pledged to defend not the Congress, nor the President, but the Constitution, above everyone and everything else.

According to our Constitution, " Treason against the (People), shall consist only in levying War against them, or in adhering to their Enemies, giving them Aid and Comfort. "
See
Selective Enforcement Versus Selective Compliance – 2 Articles

Clearly, acts that betray our Constitution or seek to destroy our heritage of freedom, regardless of how well-intentioned, are acts of treason and must be opposed as such.

Today, we are witnessing a treasonous, slow-motion coup d'etat of law enforcement taking place in America that threatens us all. Across this great country, once celebrated as the " freest country on Earth, " American citizens find heavily armed soldiers and rogue officials " levying War against them, " kicking down doors with the slightest of evidence, invading homes and dragging nonviolent citizens off to jail.
See
Drug-Crazed Racist Gang Paid By Mayor Drags Man Naked From Home –
Makes Him Wear Drag
and
Marijuana Bursts Into House And Kills Kansas Man As His Daughter Screams! Well, Actually, It Was The Police Who Killed Him, Which May Be Why The Story Isn’t On The National News
and
Family Of Malibu Millionaire Murdered In 1992 By Narks Trying to Steal His Ranch Will Be Given $5 Million Because Officials " feared jurors would not believe government agents. "

To paraphrase the Declaration of Independence, " The Police have erected a multitude of New Offices, and sent hither swarms of Officers to harass our people, and eat out their substance. "

Just look at what has happened since the passage of Prop. 215, California's historic medical marijuana law. Before the election. the police and even California's Attorney General Dan Lungren, advised voters in the Ballot Guide that Prop. 215 would " legalize marijuana. "

After the passage of 215 (by more votes than those cast for Bill Clinton), Lungren and the police decided that the election meant nothing and The Compassionate Use Act would not be enforced. Since then arrests for marijuana have actually shot up 12%. Bona fide medical marijuana patients who thought they were protected by the new law learned the same bitter lesson taught to the Soviet people by Josef Stalin who said, " Those who cast the votes decide nothing. Those who count the votes decide everything. "

When California police and prosecutors decided to ignore a law voted in by the People -- they committed treason. If 'treason' seems too harsh a word, then what would you call it when the police start deciding what laws get enforced and what votes get counted? Police and prosecutors are supposed to serve the People -- not the other way around.

And what would you call it when our elected official are afraid to do anything about it? The brave men and women who founded this country would have called it treason and would have long ago demanded the arrest of our corrupt officials, especially the ones who proclaim they are " tough on drugs, " for " adhering to (our) Enemies, giving them Aid and Comfort. "

This blatant attempt to overthrow democratic elections and our Constitutional form of government is driven by an ideology of Zero Tolerance that directly contradicts our American tradition of tolerance for other races, religions and creeds. For the past two decades, this un-American, un-Constitutional Zero Tolerance ideology has been hammered into elementary school kids and their families, by a police organization called DARE -- at
public expense-- in a desperate effort to " do something about drugs. "
See
Venom and Irrationality from a DARE Mother. Teach Your Children Well…
and links

Perhaps " SCARE " would be a better name for an organization that is currently receiving public funding of $2 billion a year to dish up whatever lies will keep kids away from dope. Police seem to think that if they scare children away from drugs, regardless of what immoral tactics may be employed, it is a moral victory. Of course the problem is that you can never create a moral society through immoral actions.
See
How the War On Marijuana To Save The Children
Has Become A War On the Children To Save Marijuana Prohibition

The DARE campaign of fear and intimidation puts every parent on notice that their child is watching them. As a result, DARE has driven a wedge of fear between families and their police. After all, any family not in compliance with Zero Tolerance could end up like the T-shirt that warns: " I turned in my parents and all I got was this lousy DARE T-shirt. "

Worst of all, DARE has been shown in one study after another that it doesn't work and actually increases the likelihood of future drug use. But don't try telling that to the police, they refuse to believe any study and talk instead of the warm feelings they have about the program and " the kids. "

However well-intentioned the effort and its officers, the reality is that DARE causes kids far more harm than good. Before DARE and Zero Tolerance, teens didn't have much to choose from -- there was beer, hard liquor and maybe marijuana. Now, after all these years and billions of dollars spent on DARE, teenagers have more dangerous drugs, more easily available and at lower prices than ever. Thanks to DARE, instead of drinking beer and smoking pot, today's DARE generation is doing acid, meth and heroin.

Following the flawed logic of DARE, should we also have SEX officers to teach elementary children to " Just say NO to sex " and to recognize sex paraphernalia and sex practices? Of course not. Parents would be outraged and complain that if you spend all that time talking about sex, it will only make students curious and make them want to experiment. Why then, do we tolerate such a flawed approach with DARE?

In the highly acclaimed book, " Smoke and Mirrors, " distinguished journalist Dan Baum, describes in detail how LAPD Police Chief Daryl Gates invented DARE to spy on students. While communist countries such as Red China, Cuba and Russia have always used police to indoctrinate young people, Gates took these communist tactics one step further by demanding each parent sign a DARE card and then investigating anyone who refused. Such practices are now banned, but they tell us much about the hidden agenda of DARE and how it " adheres to our Enemies, giving them Aid and Comfort. "

It took 200 years for America to reach a prison population of 1 million. Under DARE and the ideology of Zero Tolerance, it has only taken another 10 years to double that population to 2 million. Is that any kind of answer for our problems?

And what about the 1 million children who have been orphaned by the war on drugs, how has DARE helped them? What about all the kids who do get arrested for marijuana? Do they deserve to be jailed, raped, and labeled as felons for the rest of their life? Which is worse, accepting that teenagers experiment with pot or throwing young experimenters in with hardened HIV-positive criminals?

The brave founders of our country understood how easily any government, including our own, can become a tyrant -- that's exactly why the Bill of Rights was written -- to protect the rights of individuals from abuse by their own government. Yet under the banner of DARE, our Bill of Rights and our freedoms, secured by the blood of American men and women, are being stolen from us by Zero Tolerance police, prosecutors and career politicians who think they know best how the rest of us should live.

Under DARE children are taught that police, not the Constitution, are the ultimate authority. Respect for rights of others becomes secondary to obeying " the rule of law, " regardless of how it may violate our Constitution.

Take a look at how the ideology of Zero Tolerance has gutted our Bill of Rights and you'll see why DARE is such a threat to all of us:

--1st Amendment free speech protection no longer applies -- Just say no to all debate on drugs.
See
From Northern Idaho to New Zealand Prohibitionists Try To Silence Reformers – 2 Stories.
and
 " A Duty To Censor Adults " Ottawa Citizen Editorial Says, " The whiff of press censorship is unmistakable. "
and
Village Voice Column Alerts Readers To Threat of Hatch-Feinstein Internet Censorship Bill

--2nd Amendment right to own a gun suspended for anyone caught with drugs.

–4th Amendment protection from unreasonable search and seizure no longer applies anyone suspected of buying, selling or using drugs -- even searches that aren't reasonable are now allowed if drugs are found.
See
The Rule of Lawlessness: Police Brazenness In The Kubby Case.
The Fourth And Fifth Amendments, Or Forfeiture and Thievery. The Choice Is Ours.

--7th Amendment guarantee of a trail by jury doesn't mean much these days. Now judges decide what defenses and witnesses defendants may or may not use. As a result, only three percent of cases ever get as far as a jury trial, the rest are all plea bargains.
See
Judge Rules Against Medical Necessity Defense For McCormick and McWilliams
There Cannot Be Even a Mention of Medical Marijuana! Defies 9th Circuit Ruling.
Press Release From McCormick and McWilliams

--8th Amendment protections from excessive bail and cruel and unusual punishments suspended for those accused of drug crimes, who regularly get harsher sentences than murderers.
See
Will Foster Denied Parole Despite Unanimous Recommendation of Parole Board!
(MarijuanaNews note: Oklahoma just did it again. The governor released two violent offenders but denied parole to Foster.)

--10th Amendment suspended as local police insist on enforcing federal laws even if they directly oppose local and state laws passed by the citizens themselves.
See
California Constitution Specifically Prohibits State Officials From Using Federal Laws
As An Excuse For Not Enforcing State Laws Like Prop 215 Without A Court Ruling.
Great Orange County Register Editorial.

Thomas Jefferson drew a clear line for when government exceeds its authority over individual behavior: " Rightful liberty is unobstructed action according to our will within limits drawn around us by the equal rights of others. I do not add 'within the limits of the law', because law is often but the tyrant's will, and always so when it violates the rights of the individual. "

Hence, whenever the government seeks to prevent a person from doing some alleged injury to himself, it acts beyond its legitimate powers and becomes a tyrant. How unfortunate that this principle -- considered so important by Jefferson and the other founders of America -- was not better articulated in our Constitution. Certainly, if citizens understood this basic principle of government, misguided federal campaigns to criminalize private behavior,
such as Prohibition and the War on Drugs, would never be tolerated.

None DARE to call it treason, but it is treason nevertheless. None DARE to call it tyranny, but it most certainly is. No matter how charming a face you may put on it, the ideology of DARE threatens us all. As C. S. Lewis once observed, " Of all tyrannies, a tyranny sincerely exercised for the good of its victims may be the most oppressive. "

THE AMERICAN MEDICAL MARIJUANA ASSOCIATION

From Kim Levin
Shasta Patients Alliance
See
One More Reason Why It Is Necessary For Lockyer To Act:
Shasta County Narks Still Will Not Accept Prop 215.
At Least Not Until After They Have Questioned The Jury
That Acquitted An Innocent Man To Find Out Why They Did Such A Strange Thing.

May 22, 2000

Hello All ~

Don't let my decrease in updates let you think Shasta County has even began to comply with California Health & Safety 11362.5, the Compassionate Use Act.

OH NO ! Law enforcement here is, instead, enforcing the law of the State of Shasta under the rule of District Attorney Mcgregor Scott and Sheriff Jim Pope. (SB 2089 - sponsors)

In these past few weeks there has been an ongoing harassment of many known medical marijuana patients. Searches on residences without search warrants, raiding gardens, stealing cannabis medication - many with NO charges being pressed or police reports being filed, as yet. The District Attorney's office even appeared at the small 8 patient, 50 plant co-op garden raid that occurred this past Friday.

The Marijuana Eradication Team (sheriff's Jim Farmer & Jerry Shearman) have been telling patients that under Shasta County medical marijuana patient guidelines that patients are allowed to culivate OR possess. And if the patient was found cultivating the officers seize the cannabis, this has been the case in most visits the MET has made to patient's residences in the past two weeks. (my comment: obviously the evidence locker at the sheriff's station must be running low of marijuana -- and the cops need more free pot!)

The Shasta County medical marijuana sheriff protocol (original SB 2089) is:
"........the standardized criteria from the California Department of Justice Advanced Training Center will be utilized as general guidelines to determine the validity of the amount of marijuana recommended and/or possessed and/or cultivated. The amounts set out in the State Department of Justice Criteria are:

-Outdoor plants 2 or
-Indoor plants 6 -
Three plants in the flowering bud stage and three plants in the vegitative (growing) stage or -Possession of processed marijuana 1.33 pounds "
See
What Part Of 'Exempt' Do California District Attorneys Still Not Understand?

Now, in reality, how is a patient expected to comply with this guideline? If 2 plants are grown, what medicine is he to supply his daily medical needs with if he cannot possess cannabis? It's an unachievable and unrealistic protocol/guideline.

Fresh from the MM March and with all the activity by the MET patients are energized and wanting to get make a change. It's not only patients and caregivers, but many non-cannabis users. The support is growing by the law breaking actions of the sheriff, MET and DA. They are out of control and it is open season on patients - this could be due to their legislative bill failure and now -revenge. A civil lawsuit against Shasta County will be
filed in the very near future. (WARNING: IF YOU LIVE IN SHASTA COUNTY AND YOUR PATIENT STATUS IS KNOWN TO THE SHERIFF OR DISTRICT ATTORNEY, you most likely will be harassed regardless of your possession and cultivation amounts.)

Our immediate project is starting a recall of the DA & Sheriff. These two (DA & sheriff) are just uncommunicative on the issue of setting realistic patient guidelines and honoring medical recommendations - it's their guideline or nothing. NO medical input what-so-ever was allowed. ANYONE with info on starting a recall or with, tips, suggestions, etc PLEASE
contact me IMMEDIATELY. This is our most pressing project (and the civil & grand jury complaint .. and the... ) and time is of the essence if we are able to this on the Nov. ballot. I've already been contacted my many who are offering to collect petition signatures ........ Meeting this week, if you are interested I will give you time and location.

Keeping faith,

peace,
~Kim Levin
Shasta Patients Alliance

Shasta County Director
American Medical Marijuana Association
